**Decided C-then-B phasing for SDD agent-role neutrality**

What: Chosen direction to close the agent-role / SDD-neutrality gap surfaced by the v2 merge audit.
Decision: Implement C now, aspire to B later — C is the first step toward B, non-throwaway.
- C = brain owns the ROLE as a PORT (contract of what a role declares: {action, model-tier, tools, reads, writes}), implemented by gentle-ai AND plain, forced to parity by a test — mirrors the existing VCS (verb contract + 2 providers) and memory (op-surface + 2 backends) patterns. Closes the one axis where brain has a contract but no real n=2.
- B (future) = brain ships its own first-party REFERENCE implementation of the C port (default per-action roles). B does not replace C; B is just a third implementer of C's port, authored by brain. So C first, then B as a provider — nothing is thrown away.
Why: goal is 'usable by other projects without being forced to adopt gentle-ai'. Today only gentle-ai has real per-phase roles; the plain engine does only op 'init' (cli.mjs:99 VALID_OPS=['init']). Neutrality is currently theoretical (n=1).
Concrete minimum for C to be real n=2 today: the plain SDD_ENGINE must implement the role port for real, not just init. Needs an ADR that extends/supersedes ADR-0019 (which currently says roles are the harness's job).
Where: brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs, brain/core/methodology/harness-contract.md, brain/project/decisions/adr-0019-harness-port.md. Audit report: docs/inbox/brain-v2-merge-audit.md + ~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/brain-v2-merge-audit.md. Related: [[architecture/v2-merge-audit]].
